articles.summary: Apogee Therapeutics (APGE) announced this morning that it has agreed to be acquired by AbbVie (ABBV) in an all-cash transaction at $135.11 per share, representing a roughly 49% premium to the stock's closing price on June 18, 2026, and valuing Apogee at approximately $10.9 billion.
